diff_summary: Replaced all 7 primitive wrapper constructor calls in BootGUI.java (new Boolean x6, new Integer x1) with the corresponding valueOf factory. Every site is used only via .toString()/.booleanValue() unwrapping or as a constructor argument to Boolean.valueOf itself -- none is compared with ==/!=, used as a monitor, stored in an IdentityHashMap, or passed to identityHashCode/wait/notify, so none is identity-sensitive. javac compiles clean with commons-codec on the classpath and no 'new Boolean('/'new Integer(' remains in the file.
